title: Price display includes VAT in the EU
statement: Prices shown to EU consumers must include VAT.

title: Cookie consent banner in the EU and UK
statement: Non-essential cookies must not be set for EU or UK visitors before they give consent through a cookie banner.

title: Sweepstakes need official rules
statement: Sweepstakes and giveaways should publish official rules including eligibility and odds.
exception_process: Legal may approve a short-form rules page for campaigns under 1000 USD in prizes.
